requirements.statement: OpenCode-installed agents have no name, model, or tools frontmatter and declare mode: subagent.

verification.evidence: opencode --standalone debug agents with a temporary config home loaded all six carapace agents with mode=subagent and no model field; a grep scan of installed agent files found no ^name:, ^tools:, or model: inherit.

requirements.statement: No OpenCode agent sets a model, so every carapace subagent inherits the orchestrator session model.

verification.evidence: OpenCode debug agents reported model=<inherit> for all six carapace agents, and the source bodies now say they inherit the parent session model.

requirements.statement: The five workers deny the subagent action; the advisor denies edit and subagent.

verification.evidence: OpenCode debug agents reported deny=['subagent', ...] on all five workers and deny=['edit', 'subagent', ...] on the advisor.

requirements.statement: No Claude-only mcp__carapace__step tool reference or model: inherit wording survives in the installed OpenCode agent output.

verification.evidence: A recursive grep across the installed OpenCode agents directory for mcp__carapace__step, model: inherit, ^name:, ^tools:, and 'via frontmatter' returned no matches; the progress-reporting bullets and model wording were rewritten in the install output only.

requirements.statement: Source agents keep frontmatter model: inherit per REQ-MI-1; only the OpenCode install output omits it.

verification.evidence: All six source agent files still contain the model: inherit frontmatter line, and the transform copies them without modification for Claude, Codex, and Cursor.

integration.entryPoint: OpenCode agent discovery from the config home

falsification.assertion: A worker cannot re-delegate: every OpenCode worker definition denies the subagent action.
falsification.evidence: OpenCode debug agents showed deny=['subagent', ...] on all five workers; OpenCode's default subagent nesting depth is one, so the Claude nested-sonnet-to-Argon path has no route in this harness.

falsification.assertion: Deprecated or Claude-only fields cannot be shipped silently: the transform rejects its own output when they survive.
falsification.evidence: The guard in toOpenCodeAgent throws when name/model/tools frontmatter, mcp__carapace__step, or model: inherit remains; the temp-install grep scan found none, and the focused installer suite passed.

outOfScope: Command file generation (REQ-OC-3) belongs to OC-COMMAND-AND-SKILL.
SKILL.md harness-neutral wording (REQ-OC-5) belongs to OC-COMMAND-AND-SKILL.
Installer test expansion and documentation (REQ-OC-6) belong to OC-TESTS and OC-DOCS.
closedRow: | 3 | `OC-AGENT-FRONTMATTER` | `IMPLEMENTATION` | `NOW` | Transform `agents/*.md` into OpenCode V2 agent files at install time: omit `model` to inherit the orchestrator's live model, drop `tools:` and `mcp__carapace__step`, add `mode: subagent`, add V2 `permissions` denying `subagent` to the five workers and `edit` to the advisor. Closes when installed agents load in OpenCode with no invalid or deprecated fields and worker re-delegation is denied. | `D-OPENCODE-SUPPORT` REQ-OC-4; `D-MODEL-INHERIT`. |
notes: The advisor also denies subagent, beyond the ticket's edit deny, to match REQ-MI-3: only the orchestrator spawns carapace agents.
Body rewrites are confined to the OpenCode install output; source agent files are untouched.
